title: Ribollita Soup
description: A hearty Italian soup made with vegetables, bread, and cannellini beans. Perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cannellini beans, vegetable broth, and chopped kale to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the cubed bread to the pot and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the ribollita hot, topped with additional bread croutons if desired.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
